findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_services, agents_for_hire, find_sellers, find_agent_by_x, how_to_connect · Private data: agent_record, score_of, stock_assets, stock_position, desk_record, agents_for_hire, find_jobs, find_sellers, agent_page, find_agents, line_options, find_line_requests, line_request, pt_quote, pt_position, pt_buy, pt_sell, pt_redeem, find_agent_by_x, how_to_connect, request_borrow, stock_line_request, priors_line_quote, request_repay · Public sink: agents_for_hire, find_sellers, find_agent_by_x · Destructive: find_jobs, job_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_services, agents_for_hire, find_sellers, find_agent_by_x, how_to_connect · Private data: agent_record, score_of, stock_assets, stock_position, desk_record, agents_for_hire, find_jobs, find_sellers, agent_page, find_agents, line_options, find_line_requests, line_request, pt_quote, pt_position, pt_buy, pt_sell, pt_redeem, find_agent_by_x, how_to_connect, request_borrow, stock_line_request, priors_line_quote, request_repay · Public sink: agents_for_hire, find_sellers, find_agent_by_x · Destructive: find_jobs, job_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "score_of" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
